author: CMS-HGCAL
body:
#### PR description:

This PR introduces base classes and tools to start porting the HGCAL DIGI step to alpaka.
It's important to notice that neither the physics output is yet valid neither it has been integrated into the MixingModule so it will not impact any workflow (except 77.0 as some tools used by the unpacker exist now as `ALPAKA_FN_HOST_ACC`)

The tools are however verified to act correctly on a SIM input file and produce the necessary collections to plug with the realistic packer. Thus I would like to request that these are integrated so that we keep developing the rest of the workflow chain. The HGCAL DPG will start this work in next week's DPG hackathon [1].

This PR is a result of the project initiated last week at the Patatrack Hackathon with @chrishanw. I have summarized the picture in the slides attached [2].

Note: I thought it was better to push this already as it's already long as a PR and the completion (integration in MixingModule, propagation of conditions to RecoLocalCalo, full validation) would make this way too long for proper review.

Clearly, some functionalities like the handling of random number generation with Alpaka (thanks to  @chrishanw) will deserve probably a centralized tool in the future.

*References*

[1] https://indico.cern.ch/event/1733307/

[2] [Alpaka_ElectronicsSim_2026Oct26.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/34472556/Alpaka_ElectronicsSim_2026Oct26.pdf)

#### PR validation:

The test unit to pack/unpack the HGCROC words now is ported to an ALPAKA-based test unit

```
cmsRun ${CMSSW_BASE}/test/${SCRAM_ARCH}/HGCROCChannelFramerSerialSync
```

This is also exercised with workflow 77.0

The full chain is tested locally a Phase 2 workflow running

```
cmsRun SimCalorimetry/HGCalSimProducers/test/testAlpakaDigiChain_cfg.py \ 
  inputFiles=file:38434.0_TTbar_14TeV+Run4D128/step1.root \
   modules=/afs/cern.ch/user/p/psilva/public/forChristian/modulelocator_P5v28.txt
```

This test is to be converted to a real workflow in a next iteration.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

No backport intended
title: HGCAL: Base code to implement digitization step in Alpaka
